subject: Draft MAP & RACI for OliveTech kickoff — internal review
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Draft MAP & RACI for OliveTech kickoff — internal review

Team —

I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) + RACI for the OliveTech kickoff and evaluation run (attached). The goal is to internalize roles now so we can send a concise, customer-facing timeline when we lock the kickoff time. High level:

- Objective: 6-week evaluation leading to pilot approval and a commercial PO. Target close window: end of Q4.
- Key success metrics for eval: latency < 120ms p50 on 2k requests/day; cost-per-1k-tokens target <$0.45; no critical security issues in questionnaire.
- Proposed kickoff date (customer-facing): week of Sep 6 — need internal sign-off this week.

What I need from you: please review the MAP_draft_OliveTech_v1.xlsx and highlight any RACI disagreements or timeline conflicts by EOD Friday. Specific asks:

1) Verify owners for these deliverables (Responsible / Accountable / Consulted / Informed):
   - Discovery call prep & success criteria
   - Architecture / network design review
   - Security questionnaire and evidence collection
   - Pilot deployment (staging)
   - Evaluation run + metric collection
   - Commercial review & contract signoff

2) Mark any items you want to move earlier or later on the timeline.
3) Confirm who will be the procurement point-of-contact to loop in for contract cadence.

RACI (high-level excerpt pasted below; full table in attachment):

- Discovery: R=Jonas, A=Marissa, C=Neha, I=Ben
- Architecture review: R=Neha, A=Marissa, C=Jonas, I=Ben
- Security questionnaire: R=Marissa, A=Marissa, C=Neha, I=Jonas
- Pilot deployment: R=Ben, A=Marissa, C=Neha, I=Jonas
- Contract signoff: R=Ben, A=Marissa, C=Jonas, I=Neha

Attachments: MAP_draft_OliveTech_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Meeting prep: I propose a 30–45 min internal sync tomorrow to walk through changes and produce a customer-facing MAP. If that works, share availability (9–11am or 3–4pm PT windows).

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0129

[Attachment: MAP_draft_OliveTech_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

Jonas — thanks for the clear draft. I made inline comments and a couple of small edits in the attached file. Key notes here:

- Security questionnaire needs earlier focus: move "evidence collection" to week 0 (before kickoff) so procurement can start reviewing items in parallel.
- For Architecture review, change R from Neha to Neha/Platform (Neha primary) and mark me as A only if architecture decisions change scope.
- Contract signoff: Ben should be listed as R for commercial terms, but add an explicit procurement checkpoint (Ben to own creating PO template).
- Pilot deployment: add a dry-run step (internal smoke test) 48 hours before customer pilot start.

I attached MAP_draft_OliveTech_v1-comments.xlsx with track changes. Also adding short notes on suggested agenda for the customer kickoff — keep it tight: 20–25 mins.

Availability: I can do an internal sync tomorrow 9:30–10:15am PT.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: MAP_draft_OliveTech_v1-comments.xlsx (xlsx)]

3) Neha: confirm SRE availability for pilot window and list any infra blockers by tomorrow noon.
